trial_court: Family Court No.1, Jodhpur (S.B.Civil Writ Petition No. 729 / 2017)
case_name: Mahendra Singh vs Smt. Rekha & Anr

parties.respondent_defendant: Smt. Rekha, wife; Urmila, minor daughter

acts_cited_auto: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

acts_cited.act: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

facts_of_case: Petitioner seeks to challenge an order directing him to pay maintenance pendente lite to respondent and her minor daughter.

legal_principles.principle: The court is under an obligation to award reasonable interim maintenance and litigation expenses having regard to the petitioner's own income and the income of the respondent.
legal_principles.held: As per the mandate of the provisions of Section 24, where the wife or husband, as the case may be, has no income sufficient for her or his support and the necessary expenses of the persons, the court is under an obligation to award to reasonable interim maintenance and litigation expenses having regard to the petitioner's own income and the income of the respondent.

legal_principles.principle: No hard and fast rule can be laid down for determination of the amount of interim maintenance.
legal_principles.held: No hard and fast rule can be laid down for determination of the amount of interim maintenance.

legal_principles.principle: The relevant consideration is the inability of the spouse to maintain himself or herself for want of independent income or inadequacy of the income to maintain at the level of social status of other spouse.
legal_principles.held: While considering the application for award of interim maintenance , the relevant consideration is the inability of the spouse to maintain him or herself for want of independent income or inadequacy of the income to maintain at the level of social status of other spouse.

legal_principles.principle: The court should determine the amount of maintenance payable to the respondent after objective consideration of the material on record.
legal_principles.held: Before determining the amount of maintenance payable to the respondent, the Family Court was under an obligation to find out after objective consideration of the material on record, as to how much is the income of the petitioner.

outcome.final_order: The court modified the trial court's order, requiring a determination of the petitioner's income before awarding interim maintenance.
